Container.Name: mywhoosh-garmin-bridge
Container.Overview: Copies MyWhoosh rides to Garmin Connect as soon as they reach Strava, then deletes the duplicate that Garmin pushes back to Strava. Receives Strava activity events from StreetSweep's worker.
Container.Description: Copies MyWhoosh rides to Garmin Connect as soon as they reach Strava, then deletes the duplicate that Garmin pushes back to Strava.

Config.Name: Events Port
Config.Description: Port StreetSweep's worker posts Strava events to (LAN only; don't expose publicly).

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: State database, Garmin login tokens and the refreshed Strava token.

Config.Name: Garmin Password
Config.Description: Garmin Connect password. With MFA, finish the first login with: docker exec -it mywhoosh-garmin-bridge python -m bridge.garmin_login

Config.Name: Bridge Secret
Config.Description: Shared secret; must match BRIDGE_SECRET in StreetSweep's worker container.

Config.Name: Strava Athlete ID
Config.Description: Your numeric Strava athlete ID (the number in strava.com/athletes/...).

Config.Name: Strava Remember Token
Config.Description: The strava_remember_token cookie from a logged-in browser. Used to download each ride and delete the Garmin duplicate; expires about every 30 days.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true: report which Strava duplicate would be deleted instead of deleting it. Set to false once the first ride looks right.

Config.Name: Token Check Interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to check that the Strava token is still valid.
